user.title: Sungrow Logger
user.description: The Logger's address. Every inverter, battery tower and meter behind it is found next and shown before anything is kept.

data_description.host: Its IP address or host name on your network.
data_description.ports: A Logger1000 can give each device its own port after the first; 8 covers that. Use 1 if everything answers on the first port.

confirm.title: Found on the Logger
confirm.description:
{devices}

Searched in {seconds} s. Submit to keep these; nothing has been written to any device. On a new search, every device found before keeps its name and entity ids.

progress.discover: Searching the Logger: asking each port and address what it is. This takes a few seconds, up to a few minutes on a slow link.

error.nothing_found: Nothing on that address answered as a Sungrow Logger, inverter, battery tower or meter. Check the address, that Modbus TCP is enabled on the Logger, and the ports.

abort.already_configured: This Logger is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Searched again; the devices are updated. Each device's page now shows its serial number and where it is connected.

init.title: Sungrow
init.description: To search the Logger again (a device added, moved or replaced), use Reconfigure on the integration's page instead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Read only: nothing is ever written to the inverters or the Logger. Gentle: every reading ten times slower and no fast follow-up after a command, for running beside another Modbus client on the same Logger. Own entities: every reading and control of the inverters, meter, Logger and towers under this integration's names (off after a move from YAML, so the house starts with exactly the entities it had).

towers.title: Battery towers

forget.title: Forget a device
forget.description: For a device that has been taken away for good. It is removed with its entities and their history links. A device that only missed a search is kept anyway; one that comes back is found by the next search (Reconfigure).

abort.no_towers: No battery towers were found on this Logger.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write holding registers through the Sungrow scheduler, by the hub name a former Modbus YAML package used.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: The hub's name under sungrow_sh_t: in YAML.

address.name: Address
address.description: Register address (as on the wire: protocol number minus one).

value.name: Value
value.description: One value, or a list for several registers.
